Package neqsim.process.equipment.stream

Class EnergyStream

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.stream.EnergyStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, ProcessElementInterface, NamedInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
EnergyBus
public class EnergyStream extends Object implements ProcessElementInterface, Cloneable
A named energy-flow connection used to couple process equipment.

The canonical stored value is duty in watts. Positive and negative values remain supported for compatibility with existing models; new equipment should use EnergyPort metadata to express physical direction instead of encoding direction only in the duty sign.

Identity equality. An energy stream is a mutable connection, not a value: duty is rewritten on every flowsheet run. It therefore inherits Object.equals(Object) and Object.hashCode() and is equal only to itself, consistent with ProcessSystem and the process-equipment classes. Compare duties explicitly with getDuty() when a value comparison is intended.

    • setDuty

      public void setDuty(double duty)
      Sets the duty in watts.

      Legacy point-to-point streams retain support for non-finite intermediate values used by existing equipment fallback calculations. Multi-party EnergyBus connections reject non-finite duties because allocation requires finite inputs.

      Parameters:
      duty - duty in W
